body.name: data-driven robust observed-moment ball
body.construction: For \(k_\alpha=\lceil8\log(2q/\alpha)\rceil\) and \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), partition the observations deterministically into \(k_\alpha\) nearly equal blocks. For each coordinate \(j\), let \(\widehat\theta_j\) be the median of its block means and let \(\widehat v_j\) be the median of the corresponding within-block empirical second moments about \(\widehat\theta_j\). Use the norm \(\|x\|_{\mathsf m}=\max_{j\le q}|x_j|\) and radius \(\widehat\rho_N=K_\alpha\{M_{\mathrm{mom}}^{2/(4+\delta)}+\sqrt{1+\max_{j\le q}\widehat v_j}\}/\sqrt N\), where \(K_\alpha\) is a fixed calibrated constant. On \(N<2k_\alpha\), declare \(\mathsf F_N\).
